items.mainDefect: The mutual-exclusion checks use truthiness, so a report with age 0 plus a timestamp, or timestamp 0 plus an age, passes validation.

secondary.defect: A report with neither age nor timestamp passes validation because both fields are optional and nothing requires exactly one of them.

items.mainDefect: exploreParams.tsx still reads the removed `visualize.yAxes` field, so flatMap returns undefined and the saved query's y-axes are lost.

secondary.defect: utils.tsx:127 (`visualize?.yAxes ?? []`) and seerSearch.tsx:179 (`v.yAxes`) also still read the removed `yAxes` field, so they silently get empty or undefined y-axes.
